_about: Career fair packages (Nov 18 2026). Prices are the owner's call; change them here. Put each Stripe Payment Link in `stripe` (https://buy.stripe.com/...). With no link the button sends an email to support instead. After paying, add the company to fair/featured.json so it shows on the student Career Fair page.

tiers.name: Featured
tiers.pitch: Get on students' radar before they walk in.
features: Your logo in "Featured at this fair" at the top of that fair in Career Fair Mode
Live from the day you buy through fair day, even before the school posts its employer list
Your posted jobs on the card, so students see them before the fair

tiers.name: Spotlight
tiers.pitch: The first company students see at the fair.
features: Listed first, in a large card with your About line and who you hire
Up to 4 of your jobs on the card, the ones you tagged for that fair first
Links to your company page, where students follow you or join your orbit

tiers.name: Campus season
tiers.pitch: Own a whole recruiting season at one school.
features: Spotlight at every fair at that school that semester
Starts the day you buy and covers fairs added later in the term
